a.lede: The president also signed an executive order requiring his government to refer to AI as Super Intelligence.
a.title: Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit

b.lede: President Donald Trump issued an executive order directing all federal agencies to stop using the term 'artificial intelligence' and instead call it 'Super Intelligence.' The president said that the new term will solve AI's branding issue and that it 'more appropriately captures the promise, potential, and rapidly advancing capabilities of these technologies.'
b.title: Trump tells federal agencies to use the term 'Super Intelligence ' instead of artificial intelligence
